tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gshin rje'i gshed yang zlog gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so//klu yi rigs mchog ston pas bya rgod phung rir dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo gsungs pa'i rjes su 'od srung la/ 'jam dpal 'di sngon 'das pa'i dus rgyal ba klu'i rigs mchog ces bya bar gyur pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// kun gzigs 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod rje btsun 'jam dpal ma 'ongs pa'i dus sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan kun tu gzigs zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so// 'jam dpal dbyangs/ 'di rje btsun ngag gi rgyal po da lta byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i mtshan no// bcom ldan gshin rje mgon po kun gzigs snying rjes khros pa'i tshul bstan pa/ gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// shantiṃ garbha ye shes snying po'i zhabs// nam mkha'i snying po khrag 'thung nag po dang*// gtsug lag dpal dge slob dpon padma 'byung*| |ba su dha ra sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// gter ston zhang khrom lha rje gnubs chung dang*// mtshur ston rin rdor sku zhang dpal gyi mtshan// tshul khrims rin chen byang chub mgon po dang*// nam mkha'i mtshan can tshul khrims mtshan can dang*// rig 'dzin gsang ba rje btsun ratna'i zhabs// mchog grub rgyal po maṅga'i mtshan can sogs// 'jam dpal rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gus pas gsol 'debs zhes sam/ mchod 'bul zhes skabs thob sbyar la/ phrin las bzhi grub cing*// don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas sa thob shog /ces pa'ang gzhan pas don gnyerami gda' yang rang la phan phyir 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ 'jam dpal yang zlog me'i spu gri'i brgyud pa la gsol 'debs dang mchod 'bul thun mong du bris pas sems can thams cad mgon po kun tu gzigs kyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig/
